guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Two-Tone Sunburst signature) / PRS Silver Sky
guitar.notes: Confirmed — John Mayer has had a long-documented signature relationship with Fender Stratocasters and more recently PRS Silver Sky.

tone.target: warm clean Fender-style pop-soul guitar with slight compression and spring reverb
tone.profile: warm clean Fender-style pop-soul guitar with slight compression and spring reverb
tone.summary: A bright, clean signal chain featuring light compression, a classic American amp model (US Deluxe), and spring reverb to capture the pop-soul feel of 'Daughters'.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and fingerpicking transients.
Provide light compression and smooth out the dynamics of fingerpicked arpeggios.
Keep the tone pristine and clean; no drive needed.
Simulate the warm, bright Fender-style clean tone and single-coil character.
Provide the classic American combo sound and single-coil voicing.
Slightly brighten the high end and round out the overall tone for pop-soul clarity.
No wah effect needed for this clean arpeggiated style.
Avoid the 'chorus wash' as requested; keep modulation minimal.
Keep the delay subtle or off to maintain intimacy and focus on arpeggios.
Add the required vintage spring reverb tail for a warm pop-soul atmosphere.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default US 2x12 IR for a more open, vintage-voiced option suitable for pop-soul.

proposals.reason: Enhance the warm, natural sound required for fingerpicked arpeggios.
